newsitem.title: USA: Reno Air says filed suit against Northwest.
newsitem.headline: Reno Air says filed suit against Northwest.

text.p: Reno Air Inc said on Thursday it had filed a lawsuit against Northwest Airlines Corp seeking to recover damages from Reno's entry into the Minneapolis/St. Paul market in 1993.
Reno Air said the amount of damages it would seek was unspecified.

"We contend that Northwest Airlines used its much larger size to foreclose competition and maintain expensive air fares," said Reno vice president and general counsel Bob Rowen. "Northwest overlapped Reno Air's service and engaged in a variety of tactics, inclusing below-cost pricing, to drive us from the market."
Northwest spokesman Jim Faulkner responded, "basically we just don't think their case has any merit."
Reno Air serves 24 cities and operates nearly 200 daily departures.
